entries.0f6a0df5694fb165: This business leverages knowledge and know-how of client operations and the company's original service U-Way. For financial institutions and retail and distribution companies, it undertakes the design, development, operation and maintenance of business applications and proposes data analysis and utilization, while for general business companies it provides everything from infrastructure to application development through U-Way. It has strengths in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, a cloud service provided by Oracle, and in the cloud ERP products Oracle NetSuite and Oracle Fusion Applications. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥3,459 million.
entries.3b1ed28ca74021f8: This is a solution-based consulting business that leads client business transformation. In addition to DX consulting services that extract issues from the DX Strategy Karte (DX diagnosis), it provides business reform consulting using the latest generative AI technology, digital and AI talent development (DX Boot Camp), and other services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥734 million.
entries.a1c2fc75f9572272: This is a single-segment business operated by the company and 1 consolidated subsidiary (CNS Hokkaido Co., Ltd.). It covers development processes from requirements definition through basic design, detailed design, manufacturing and testing, and from the fiscal year ended May 2026 is organized into a divisional structure with 3 businesses: the Technology Solutions Business, the Business Solutions Business and the Consulting Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥7,774 million.
entries.df09dfa8e592a57a: This business is responsible for solving client issues through the use of advanced technologies. It provides end-to-end consulting, implementation and operation for the ServiceNow cloud service, which integrates, automates and visualizes business processes, and also handles next-generation technology research and development, technical consulting such as database migration, agile development using AI, IoT and cloud, and technical consulting, implementation, construction and operation of infrastructure environments from on-premises to cloud. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥3,579 million, the largest of the 3 businesses.
entries.e94fc5fbbf9ed53a: A systems engineering company that provides customers such as financial institutions and major SI providers with services from system design and development to operation and maintenance, and DX consulting.
